policy: Only approved direct Go module dependencies may be added. Transitive dependencies are accepted through the approved direct dependency graph and must not become direct dependencies without an allowlist entry.
assertions: direct non-standard Go modules must be explicitly approved
approved direct modules must declare layer, owner, reason, and approval
new platform dependencies must appear as executable policy, not reviewer memory

loop.observation: A strict no-external-dependency rule blocked platform observability dependencies while ad hoc exceptions would make dependency policy reviewer-memory based.
loop.hypothesis: An executable allowlist can preserve dependency governance while allowing approved platform dependencies for contracts and observability.
loop.execute: Load go list module metadata, compare direct non-standard dependencies against this allowlist, and fail on unapproved, duplicate, or unused allowlist entries.
loop.evaluate: CI uploads dependency-allowlist evidence with status, direct dependency counts, and this loop metadata.
loop.retrospective: Dependency policy remains machine-verifiable while approved SDKs stay scoped by layer, owner, and reason.
